pins.head: A SCREEN, NOT A WALL
pins.title: Studio Apartment Zones: Split One Room Without Building Walls
pins.desc: A folding screen or a tall open shelf marks where sleeping ends and sitting begins, and neither one needs a landlord to sign anything. Put the divider where the walking path already bends so the room still reads as one space. Contains affiliate links. #StudioApartment #SmallSpaceLiving #RoomDivider
pins.alt: A studio apartment with a rattan folding screen beside the bed, a teal sofa and round coffee table, and potted plants along a wall of windows.

pins.head: POUCHES REFILL THE PUMPS
pins.title: Shampoo and Body Wash Refills: Pouch or New Bottle?
pins.desc: A refill pouch is usually cheaper per ounce than another pump bottle, but only when the pouch size matches how fast you get through it. Work out the ounces you use in a month first, then pick the pouch that lands nearest that number. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomRefills #ShampooRefill #LowWasteHome
pins.alt: Two pump bottles and two white refill pouches standing on a bright bathroom counter by a window.

pins.head: NO DRILL, NO LOST DEPOSIT
pins.title: Small Bathroom Storage That Needs No Drilling
pins.desc: Tension rods, over-the-door racks and a freestanding shelf unit carry most of a small bathroom without a single hole in the tile. Measure the strip of floor beside the toilet before you buy anything, because that is usually the only space left. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBathroom #RenterFriendly #BathroomStorage
pins.alt: A small bathroom with a wood vanity, a potted plant on the windowsill and a white shelf unit of folded towels beside the toilet.

pins.head: THIN CUTS NEED A SLOW HAND
pins.title: Transfer Tape for Vinyl: Peel Slowly and at a Low Angle
pins.desc: Pulling transfer tape straight up stretches the thin cuts and drops the small ones. Lay the tape down, burnish it, then peel back on itself almost flat against the mat so the vinyl lets go a little at a time. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #TransferTape #CricutTips
pins.alt: An orange leaf decal and a wooden scraper lying on a green cutting mat at a sunlit workbench.

pins.head: FOUR MOLDS, ONE SET
pins.title: Round Silicone Coaster Molds for Epoxy Resin Casting
pins.desc: Separate round molds flex more than one rigid tray, so a cured coaster pops out without bending at the rim. Four in a set means a whole pour cures at once instead of waiting on a single cavity to free up. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #CoasterMolds #EpoxyResin
pins.alt: Round silicone coaster molds holding cured amber resin discs on a black work mat, with a hand flexing one mold open.

pins.head: A RISER HIDES THE CLUTTER
pins.title: Small Home Office Organization: Use the Space Under the Screen
pins.desc: A riser turns the footprint of the screen into a shelf, and the pens, notes and cables that were spread over the desk tuck underneath it. Nothing new has to go on the wall and nothing new has to be measured. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #DeskSetup #SmallSpaceOffice
pins.alt: A wood desk under a window with a laptop raised on a stand, a file sorter, a small lamp and a teal chair.

pins.head: THE FERRULE IS THE WEAK SPOT
pins.title: Paint Brush Care: Dry Brushes Upright, Never Tip Down
pins.desc: Water that sits in the ferrule swells the handle and loosens the glue, and that is what splays a brush long before the hairs wear out. Reshape the tip while it is damp, then stand each brush in a rack with the bristles touching nothing. Contains affiliate links. #PaintBrushCare #AcrylicPainting #CraftStation
pins.alt: Paint brushes standing bristles-up in a wooden rack on a workbench beside a glass jar and a folded cloth.

pins.head: THE SPACE UNDER THE BED
pins.title: Small Bedroom Organization: Store Off-Season Things Under the Bed
pins.desc: Measure the gap between the floor and the bed frame before buying bins, because the lid is the part that usually will not clear. Clear sides save you pulling every box out to find one jumper in October. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBedroom #UnderBedStorage #BedroomOrganization
pins.alt: A small bedroom with a teal bed, a clear storage bin under the frame, a clothes rail and a bedside table.

pins.head: COUNT ROLLS, NOT PACKS
pins.sub: What a Mega Roll Really Is
pins.title: Paper Goods: Compare Sheet Count Before Pack Size
pins.desc: A pack of six mega rolls and a pack of twelve regular rolls can hold the same paper, so the number on the front tells you almost nothing. Find the total sheet count on the side panel and divide the price by that instead. Contains affiliate links. #HouseholdEssentials #PaperTowels #BulkBuying
pins.alt: Rolled paper towels on an upper shelf and folded towels stacked below in a pale linen cupboard.

pins.head: HOOKS CARRY THE DOOR
pins.kicker: Hang it, do not drill it
pins.title: Renter Entryway Storage: Over-the-Door Hooks and a Free-Standing Rack
pins.desc: An over-the-door hook rail and a free-standing coat tree take the coats, bags and scarves that otherwise land on a chair, and both leave the walls as you found them. Keep the floor under them clear so shoes still have somewhere to go. Contains affiliate links. #EntrywayOrganization #RenterFriendly #NoDrillStorage
pins.alt: An entryway with a wooden coat tree holding bags, a low shoe rack, a small table and hooks over the door holding a coat.

pins.head: A STICK FITS ANY BOTTLE
pins.title: Electrolyte Powder Sticks: A Variety Pack for the Drawer
pins.desc: Single-serve sticks travel better than a tub and save you guessing at a scoop, and a variety pack shows which flavour you actually finish before you commit to a box of one. Stand them on edge in a divider so you can read the row. Contains affiliate links. #Electrolytes #HydrationTips #SnackDrawer
pins.alt: White single-serve stick packs standing on edge in clear drawer dividers inside an open wooden drawer.

pins.head: THE PIPES SET THE WIDTH
pins.title: Under-Sink Organizer Size Guide: Measure Around the Plumbing
pins.desc: The cabinet opening is not the usable width; the drain stack and the shut-off valves are. Run a tape across the floor of the cabinet and then up to the lowest pipe, and buy to the smaller of those two numbers. Contains affiliate links. #SmallKitchen #UnderSinkStorage #KitchenOrganization
pins.alt: An open under-sink cabinet with a tape measure laid across the base and white drain pipes running above it.
